results.name: Ink Headline
results.description: Ink-in headline: each word soaks into the page like ink, bleeds out into the paper with a pooled outline, then dries into the real text as the outline fades. Real, selectable, accessible text throughout. Word by word, line by line or all at once; in view, scroll-scrubbed or controlled. React only, one WebGL context for any number of headlines. npx @21st-dev/cli add @ryanonline1234/ink-headline

results.name: HeroUI Select
results.description: Accessible select built on React Aria, from HeroUI v3. A collapsible listbox with single and multiple selection, descriptions, grouped sections with headers and separators, disabled options, controlled value, primary/secondary variants, and full keyboard + typeahead support. Compound API: Select / Select.Trigger / Select.Value / Select.Indicator / Select.Popover + ListBox / ListBox.Item / ListBox.ItemIndicator / ListBox.Section / Header / Separator / Label / Description / FieldError.
